name: Path Traversal
summary: External input influences filesystem paths without normalization or allowlisting, which can expose files outside the intended directory.

name: OS Command Injection
summary: Untrusted input is incorporated into an OS command, allowing attackers to execute arbitrary shell instructions.

name: Cross-Site Scripting
summary: User-controlled content is rendered into HTML or a browser context without appropriate output encoding or sanitization.

name: SQL Injection
summary: Untrusted input is concatenated into SQL statements, which lets attackers alter query structure and exfiltrate or modify data.

name: Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm
summary: Weak or obsolete cryptographic primitives reduce resistance to brute force, collision, or confidentiality attacks.

name: Deserialization of Untrusted Data
summary: Serialized attacker-controlled data is deserialized without validation, allowing code execution or logic compromise.
owasp: A08:2021 - Software and Data Integrity Failures

name: Hard-coded Credentials
summary: Secrets embedded in source code can be extracted from the repository, build artifacts, or logs and reused by attackers.

name: Server-Side Request Forgery
summary: The server issues outbound requests based on attacker-controlled destinations, potentially reaching internal services or cloud metadata endpoints.
